Ava: Quick challenge — best 1-liner + GIF. Winner gets the last cinnamon roll in the kitchen. Drop it now! :cookie:

Jordan: 😂 that GIF. Also my one-liner: "Coffee: because adulting is a series of bad decisions with espresso." :coffee:

Ben: "My couch and I are in a committed meeting. No interruptions." :zzz:
Maya: GIF drop: https://giphy.com/gifs/dance-happy-10dU7AN7xsi1I8

kudos-bot: Maya awarded a kudos to Priya for 'snack diplomacy' :star:
Priya: wow thanks @Maya :blush:

Jordan: noted. offering 1-liner stewardship if required :ok_hand:

Maya: :thumbsup:
